**Finding submitted — deviation (LOL-CAP).**

- **What the document says:** Section 15 ("Limitation of Garman's Liability", ¶p0105) is the only liability provision — I confirmed no "aggregate liability" or cap language appears anywhere else, including the warranty (§12) and the nominal "IP Indemnity" (§13, which in fact contains only an ownership statement).
- **Assessment:** The clause is mutual on the indirect/consequential damages exclusion and already carves Sections 13 and 14 out of the limitation, but it contains **no monetary cap at all**. Both parties — including Sparkling — therefore face unlimited exposure for direct damages, which fails the fallback (mutual cap of 12 months' fees) on a material term.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Minimal edit to the final sentence of ¶p0105 adding the preferred mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000), converting the existing §13/§14 carve-out into an uncapped "Excluded Claims" definition (adding indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement), and confirming our fee obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes.
